digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime auth injection via ProviderSession
propositions: Add LLMRuntime typed auth/session capabilities in src/rebar/llm/auth.py that accept provider-native credentials (boto3 Session, Anthropic access-token provider, OpenAI workload identity) without serializing to LLMConfig, RunRequest, or snapshots.

Extend PydanticAIRunner and get_runner to accept optional LLMRuntime and pass it into the single per-run ProviderSession builder, enriching only Anthropic/Bedrock/OpenAI client construction while preserving Rebar ownership and RP-01 policy.
Ensure provider-native auth fails before a provider model request if explicit auth is absent or conflicting, with no fallback to anonymous, alternate-principal, or cross-provider construction.
Verify unchanged RP-01 authoritative offline oracles (S2/S3/S5), candidate-tracing, one-Agent-per-run budget, cache accounting, and exhaustion contracts all remain green.
Guard that auth injection path creates exactly one ProviderSession, one official client lifecycle, and one Agent operation per run with no bespoke retry scheduler or second client owner.
Bounded live Anthropic and Bedrock auth/cache canaries pass with provider-native principals (AWS workload identity) and redacted evidence recorded without credential material leakage.
